families.name: spindle_http_requests_total
families.summary: Requests the run answered outside /__spindle/, by method, route template, operation, kind, class and status class; an unrouted request has an empty route, operation and kind.

families.name: spindle_http_request_duration_seconds
families.summary: From a request's head read to its answer handed back, on the listener thread, for every request counted by spindle_http_requests_total, by method and route template; an unrouted request has an empty route.

families.name: spindle_commands_total
families.summary: Commands executed, by the declared outcome the model selected.

families.name: spindle_command_failures_total
families.summary: Commands the kernel did not execute, by why.

families.name: spindle_command_duration_seconds
families.summary: How long the kernel took to execute a command.

families.name: spindle_bindings_total
families.summary: Envelopes of an event binding, by what happened to each: sent, delivered, redelivered or dropped, at the component that measured it.

families.name: spindle_binding_retries_total
families.summary: Invocations of a retrying binding's command, attempted or exhausted.

families.name: spindle_timer_ticks_total
families.summary: Ticks of a periodic binding, fired, late or dropped.

families.name: spindle_entity_rows
families.summary: Rows each entity holds now, kept from the writes this process lands and taken once from its store when the store opens; written from the first scrape that finds the entity holding a row, and falls on a reset.

families.name: spindle_resets_total
families.summary: Resets of the run's stores through POST /api/reset.

families.name: spindle_external_causes_total
families.summary: External causes a served command asked about, by what answered each: world, file, default, call or unanswered.

families.name: spindle_bound_refusals_total
families.summary: Commands an event binding invoked while a request was answered that were refused, as the request's record lists them, by binding, command and refusal: the refusing outcome, or the kernel's error kind where it selected none.

families.name: spindle_seed_commands_total
families.summary: Entries of the run's seed file: sent, then each applied, already_there (an existing_instance: outcome, or a request id an earlier entry carried) or refused; written from the first scrape of a run given a seed, absent without one.

families.name: spindle_metrics_scrape_duration_seconds
families.summary: How long the last GET /__spindle/metrics before this one took to read the counts and write them; absent until one was answered.

families.name: spindle_metrics_series_mode
families.summary: 1, labelled with how the run writes the labels whose values come from the specification: per-command, each value its own series, or aggregated, every route, operation, command, outcome, event, binding and entity, and each refusal that names a declared outcome, written empty and the series that then share their labels summed.
